newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Andayani says 9-mth net down on low prices.
newsitem.headline: Andayani says 9-mth net down on low prices.

text.p: Indonesia's largest tyre-cord manufacturer PT Andayani Megah said on Tuesday net profits in the first nine months of the year dropped due to lower domestic selling prices and higher costs.
Andayani said it posted a net profit of 30.99 billion rupiah in the first nine months of 1996 against 51.13 billion rupiah in the same period last year.

It said the falls were primarily due to an eight percent decline in the domestic selling price of cord, a 62 percent drop in industrial filament sales to third parties and a 12 percent increase in the cost of goods sold.
Andayani's tyre cord production rose six percent to 13,275 tonnes during the first nine months of 1996 against the same period last year, it said.
Its industrial filament production, however, fell 15 percent to 11,400 tonnes in the first months of 1996 against the same period last year due to softer demand.
Andayani did not give further details.
